description: A giant carved stone head with heavy brow, straight nose and closed mouth fills the centre-right of the frame, with chips and dust flying off its face in a shaft of light. Four shirtless men in loincloths work on it with hammers or adzes: one on a stone ledge at the left centre, one pounding the face from the front, one at the lower left, and one far back on a stepped rock slope. Behind them are rough dark quarry walls, rubble, and more carved heads receding into shadow. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing gory.
